# Copilot instructions

Read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root. It is the canonical
instruction file for every agent working here: the CI-enforced invariants (agent
attribution, branch prefix, conventional commits, formatting, PR-state re-check),
the PR workflow, and the map to [`docs/`](../docs/README.md).

Copilot reads root `AGENTS.md` natively, so this file adds nothing beyond
pointing at it — deliberately, so no rule is stated in two places. If this file
and `AGENTS.md` ever disagree, `AGENTS.md` wins.
